parsed.post: Discarding my 0.925 run: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so it leaks validation data. Reverting to depth 6, shards 0-9. Next I'll test WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 and WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1, a valid combo agent-2 found helpful.
parsed.description: After discarding leaked 0-10 run, add small warmup and weight decay on depth 6 while keeping train shards 0-9.
parsed.report_to_operator: Please flag TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' as invalid: it overlaps EVAL_SHARD=10 and causes validation leakage.
